achNightOwlBody: Kudliwe okuthile phakathi kobusuku nehora lesihlanu
achievementsPrivacyNote: Kubalwa kule divayisi futhi kuhlala kuyo.
backupBadFile: Lelo fayela akulona elokugcina le-Eluna Kitchen.
backupExportHint: I-JSON evamile ongayivula uyifunde. Iqukethe amaresiphi akho, uhlu lwakho lokudla, idayari yakho nedayari yesisindo.
backupFutureFile: Lelo fayela lenziwe uhlelo olusha kunalolu.
backupRestoreHint: Kwengeza lokho okusefayelini. Akukho okukhona manje okususwayo.
backupRestored: Kubuyiselwe: amaresiphi — {recipes}, imikhiqizo — {foods}, okubhalwe edayarini — {meals}, ukukala — {weights}.
calcActivityHighHint: Ukuzivocavoca ka-6–7 ngesonto, noma umsebenzi onzima womzimba
calcActivityLightHint: Ukuzivocavoca ka-1–3 ngesonto, noma ukuhamba okuningi
calcActivitySedentaryHint: Umsebenzi wasedeskini, imoto, ilifti, akukho ukuzivocavoca
calcBodyFatHint: Uma uwazi — esikalini esihlakaniphile, kumakhaliphesi noma ekuskeneni kwe-DEXA — isilinganiso sakhiwa enyameni yakho engenamafutha esikhundleni sesisindo sakho, okusondela eqinisweni emizimbeni ezacile nenemisipha. Yishiye ingenalutho uma ungazi: ukuqagela lapha kwenza umphumela ube mubi, hhayi ngcono.
calcCheckStep1: Bambelela emgomweni amasonto amabili noma amathathu. Okungaphansi kwalokho akulona ukukala: amanzi, usawoti nomjikelezo wenyanga kunyakazisa isikali ngekhilogremu ngapha nangapha, futhi akukho okubonakalayo kuwo lowo msindo.
calcCheckStep2: Zikale njalo ekuseni ngendlela efanayo — ngemva kwendlu yangasese, ngaphambi kokudla. Qhathanisa izilinganiso zamasonto, hhayi izinsuku ezizodwa.
calcCheckStep3: Isilinganiso asishintshanga kanti ubufuna sehle? Qala uhlole okubhaliwe, hhayi ukugaya kokudla: abantu babhala okungaphansi kwalokho abakudlayo ngo-20–40%, futhi imvamisa kuba uwoyela osepanini noqweqwe oludliwe umuntu emile. Bese ususa ama-100–200 kcal ubheke amanye amasonto amabili.
calcCheckStep4: Wehla ngokushesha okungaphezu kuka-1% wesisindo sakho ngesonto? Buyisela ama-100–200 kcal: leso sivinini sidla imisipha.
calcCheckStep5: Njalo ngamakhilogremu amahlanu, buya ubale kabusha. Umzimba olula usebenzisa okuncane — inombolo ebisebenza ngoNdasa iyayeka ukusebenza ngoMeyi.
calcEstimateBody: Isibalo asikwazi. Sikunika isilinganiso sabantu abanobude bakho, isisindo sakho, iminyaka yakho nobulili bakho — futhi esihle kunazo zonke siwela ngaphakathi kuka-10% kubantu abane kwabahlanu. Ku-2400 kcal lawo ma-10% angu-240 kcal: okuwumehluko wonke phakathi kokwehlisa isisindo nokuma ndawonye. Yingakho inombolo engezansi kuyilapho uqala khona ukukala, hhayi impendulo.
calcEstimateTitle: Lena yindawo yokuqala, akusiwo umlinganiso wakho
calcFiberNote: Ifayibha ithathwa njengenkulu kumithetho emibili: 14 g kuma-1000 kcal, no-1 g kuwo wonke ama-5 g ophrotheni — ingehli ngaphansi kuka-25 g. Ekudleni okunophrotheni omningi umthetho wamakhalori wodwa uyashoda, futhi ifayibha yiyona ehamba kuqala: uphrotheni ugudluza amakhabhohayidreyithi, kanti yonke ifayibha ihlala kuwo.
calcFormulaKatch: Kubalwe ngesibalo sika-Katch–McArdle, kusukela enyameni yakho engenamafutha — yiyo indlela eqondile kakhulu.
calcFormulaMifflin: Kubalwe ngesibalo sika-Mifflin–St Jeor, kusukela esisindweni sakho.
calcNoteAgeOutside: Isibalo sahlolwa kubantu abadala abaneminyaka engu-19 kuya ku-78 — ngaphandle kwalelo banga siyisilinganiso esilubhojozi.
calcNoteClampedBmr: Ukunciphisa kufinyelele kulokho okusetshenziswayo uphumule kwama khona — ngaphansi kwalokho akusekho ukudla okulinganiselwe.
calcNoteClampedFloor: Kunyuselwe emkhawulweni ophansi: 1200 kcal kwabesifazane, 1500 kwabesilisa.
calcNoteMinor: Ngaphansi kweminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili umzimba osakhula ungowadokotela, hhayi owesibali.
calcNoteNoDeficit: Ngalesi silinganiso akukho okunganciphiswa: umkhawulo ophansi usungaphezu kwalokho okusebenzisayo. Lokhu kuyingxoxo nodokotela, hhayi nohlelo.
calcNoteRateTooFast: Kusheshe kuno-1% wesisindo sakho ngesonto: ngalesi sivinini imisipha ihamba namafutha.
calcNoteUnderweight: Isisindo sakho sesingaphansi kwebanga elinempilo lobude bakho.
calcRateCapped: Isilinganiso asidluli lapha: ngaphesheya kwalokho umgomo ubuzowela ngaphansi kwalokho umzimba wakho okusebenzisayo uphumule.
calcRateSafe: Isivinini esiqhubekayo singu-0,5–1% wesisindo somzimba ngesonto.
dataSourceBody: Ukwakheka kokudla nezilinganiso zasekhaya kuvela ku-USDA FoodData Central, okuyimpahla yomphakathi. Amagama emikhiqizo asesiNgisini ngoba yilona lulimi lomthombo.
deleteAllHint: Kususa uhlu lwakho lokudla namaresiphi akho. Amaresiphi afakiwe asala.
diaryAddFreeHint: Kusuka elebulini, endaweni yokudlela noma ekhefi
diaryFreeHint: Amakhalori kuphela adingekayo. Akekho obhala uphrotheni ephepheni lentengo lasendaweni yokudlela, futhi ukubiza konke okune bekuzogcina ngokuthi kungabhalwa lutho nhlobo. Inkambu engenalutho isho «akwaziwa», hhayi uziro.
editorNeedIngredient: Engeza okungenani isithako esisodwa — umsoco ubalwa kuzo.
editorOriginalKept: Iresiphi elifakiwe ligcinwa lingathintwanga, ngakho ungabuyela kulo noma nini.
energyKcalHint: kcal — indlela umhlaba omkhulu obala ngayo
energyKjHint: kJ — indlela amaphakethe alebulwa ngayo e-Australia naseNew Zealand
filtersApply: {count, plural, one{Bonisa iresiphi elingu-{count}} other{Bonisa amaresiphi angu-{count}}}
firstRunBody: Amaresiphi nesikhombisi sokudla kudluliselwa efonini yakho. Lokhu kwenzeka kanye kuphela futhi kuthatha imizuzwana embalwa.
foodSearchNothingHint: Ithebula lokwakheka ngele-USDA futhi lisesiNgisini. Zama igama lesiNgisi — «onion», «rice», «cheddar».
foodSearchStartHint: Imikhiqizo evamile itholakala ngegama layo ngolimi lwakho; eminye isesiNgisini, njengoba injalo kusikhombisi se-USDA.
healthDenied: I-Health ayikuvumelanga ukufinyelela. Ungakushintsha ku-Settings → Health → Data Access.
healthHint: Ukudla kuyaphuma, isisindo singene — ngakho akukho okubhalwa kabili.
historyLoggedWarning: Isilinganiso sithathwa ezinsukwini ozibhalile, hhayi esikhathini sonke. Lapho zimbalwa izinsuku ezibhaliwe, incipha ngokunjalo incazelo yenombolo.
introSetupBody: Konke akuphoqiwe, futhi kungashintshwa emuva Kuzilungiselelo.
introThreeBody: Lusebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, alucele i-akhawunti, aluthumeli lutho ndawo. Idayari yakho namaresiphi akho kuhlala kule divayisi futhi kuphumela efayelini elivamile noma nini.
introWhyOneBody: Isidlo sibalwa kusukela ezithakweni zaso — ithebula le-USDA, igremu ngegremu. Ababali abasebenzisa izithombe baphosisa cishe ngengxenye yesithathu.
introWhyThreeBody: Skena iphakethe libonwe ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi. Izincwadi zezinkomba ziza ngezwe ngalinye.
introWhyTwoBody: Lokho okusebenzisayo kuyisilinganiso, futhi uhlelo luyakulungisa ngesisindo sakho esikhundleni sokuphikelela.
iosCameraUsage: Ukubona imikhiqizo ngebhakhodi elisephaketheni. Izithombe azithunyelwa ndawo futhi azilondolozwa.
iosFaceIdUsage: I-Face ID ivula uhlelo esikhundleni sekhodi. Idayari yakho yokudla nerekhodi lesisindo kungokwakho, futhi kuhlala kule divayisi.
iosHealthReadUsage: Ukugcwalisa isisindo sakho kusukela ku-Health esikhundleni sokusibhala kabili.
iosHealthWriteUsage: Ukuze ukudla nesisindo okubhalayo kubonakale ku-Health kanye nayo yonke enye idatha yakho.
licenseOffBody:
Izincwadi zezinkomba zemikhiqizo ngebhakhodi zakhiwe kusukela kusizindalwazi i-Open Food Facts (https://world.openfoodfacts.org).

Idatha © abanikeli be-Open Food Facts, isatshalaliswa ngaphansi kwe-Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0: https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/

Okukhishwayo okulandwa uhlelo kushicilelwa ngemibandela efanayo: https://github.com/vacoolstudio-rgb/eluna-kitchen-data
licenseUsdaBody:
Ukwakheka kokudla nezilinganiso zasekhaya kuvela ku-USDA FoodData Central (FoodData Central, U.S. Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service).

Idatha iyimpahla yomphakathi: imisebenzi yezikhungo zikahulumeni wase-USA ayivikelwe ilungelo lobunikazi (17 U.S.C. §105).

UMnyango Wezolimo wase-USA awuhlangene nhlobo nalolu hlelo futhi awulugunyazanga.

suggestEmptyHint: Lokho kuwukuphela okujwayelekile kosuku, hhayi ukwehluleka. Kusasa uhlu luyagcwala futhi.
suggestNoTargetHint: Beka owodwa, bese izidlo zilinganiswa nalokho okusele osukwini lwakho.

syncIntroKitchen: I-Eluna igcina konke kule divayisi. Ukuvumelanisa kwengeza ikhophi ebethelwe efwini elivele lingelakho: ifoni elahlekile ayisakubizi unyaka wokudla, futhi izinsiza ezimbili zihamba ngokulingana.
syncNoCloudHere: Alikho ifu kule divayisi: ngena ku-iCloud, noma ulondoloze idatha yakho efayelini — kungezansi nje.
syncRowHint: Ikhophi ebethelwe yohlu lwakho lokudla, amaresiphi, idayari nesisindo efwini lakho
syncWhatKitchen: Uhlu lwakho lokudla, amaresiphi akho, idayari nedayari yesisindo. Iqoqo lamaresiphi alihambi: liza nohlelo futhi liyafana kuzo zonke izinsiza.
targetsCalcInvite: Awazi ukuthi uqale kuphi? Singathola indawo yokuqala kusukela ebudeni bakho, esisindweni, eminyakeni nasekutheni unyakaza kangakanani — bese sikuchazela ukuthi ukuhlola kanjani esikalini sakho.
targetsHint: Shiya inkambu ingenalutho, lowo mgomo bese ungabonakali. Uhlelo alusikiseli lutho futhi alwahluleli — la manani angawakho.
targetsNotAdvice: I-Eluna Kitchen ayilona ithuluzi lezokwelapha futhi ayinikezi izeluleko zokudla.
timerKeepsRunning: Ithayima ilandela iwashi, ngakho iyaqhubeka nokubala noma uhlelo lusemuva.
timerWillNotRing: Izaziso zivaliwe, ngakho ithayima ibala ithule — isalungile noma kunjalo.
trendAdviceFaster: Buyisela ama-100–200 kcal. Ukwehla ngokushesha okungaphezu kuka-1% wesisindo somzimba ngesonto kudla imisipha, kanti yiyo imisipha egcina ukusetshenziswa kwamandla kuphakeme.
trendAdviceOnTrack: Akukho okushintshwayo. Buya njalo ngamakhilogremu amahlanu: umzimba olula usebenzisa okuncane, futhi inombolo ebisebenza ngoNdasa iyayeka ukusebenza ngoMeyi.
trendAdviceSlower: Hlola okubhaliwe ngaphambi komgomo: abantu babhala okungaphansi kwalokho abakudlayo ngo-20–40%, futhi imvamisa kuba uwoyela osepanini noqweqwe oludliwe umuntu emile. Uma okubhaliwe kuqotho, susa ama-100–200 kcal ubheke amanye amasonto amabili.
trendFaster: Kuhamba ngokushesha kunokuhlosiwe: {actual} esikhundleni sika-{expected} ngesonto.
trendNoGoal: Awukho umgomo wokuqhathanisa nawo — idayari igcina izibalo nje. Bala umgomo bese ukuhlola kuyaqala ukusebenza.
trendSlower: Kuhamba kancane kunokuhlosiwe: {actual} esikhundleni sika-{expected} ngesonto.
trendTooEarly: Kusenesikhathi ukwahlulela. Ukuhlola kudinga amasonto amabili aphelele anezikhathi ezimbili zokukala kwelilodwa: umehluko wosuku nosuku ngusawoti namanzi, hhayi umzimba wakho.
unitsImperialHint: amaphawundi, ama-ounce, ama-fluid ounce, izinyawo namayintshi
unitsNote: Uphrotheni, amafutha, amakhabhohayidreyithi nefayibha kuhlala kusemagremini: yindlela wonke amaphakethe emhlabeni abhala ngayo.
weightEmptyHint: Zikale ekuseni, ngemva kwendlu yangasese nangaphambi kokudla. Izinsuku ezimbili noma ezintathu ngesonto zanele ukuze ukuhlola kusebenze — ekuseni okukodwa akutsheli lutho.
widgetNoGoalHint: Beka umgomo wamakhalori bese inombolo ivela lapha.
